title: Mogul Steamship Co Ltd v McGregor, Gow & Co

content.caseIdentity: Mogul Steamship Co Ltd v McGregor, Gow & Co, [1892] AC 25
content.facts: Intentional procurement of breach may be actionable, while lawful competition causing loss is not by itself a tort.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: Intentional procurement of breach may be actionable, while lawful competition causing loss is not by itself a tort.
content.holding: Intentional procurement of breach may be actionable, while lawful competition causing loss is not by itself a tort.
content.relevance: Apply the ratio to the proved facts.
